decisions.reason: A multi-model track spotlight line presented on its own page for two years represents visible, sustained commitment within the firm's core modular system, so dropping it would write off investment and contradict the firm's announced system strategy.
This ceiling luminaire line has had its own page since 2023 and sits at the heart of the established range, so the sunk investment and public presentation favor persisting with it.
Launched only in 2024 as a multi-model line with its own page, any weak early results can still be attributed to a ramp-up phase, and the fresh public commitment argues for keeping it.
The multi-outlet canopy is a system accessory that supports the firm's flexible-system promise and was presented prominently, so dropping it soon after launch would expose the decision as a mistake.
The low-voltage canopy complements the modular offer and has its own page, and being newly launched, its disappointing results can still be read as temporary.

The round glass track luminaires were only mentioned rather than featured, so the firm's public commitment is weaker, but as a recent multi-model line within the track system it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
